get_unread_count.doc: Get count of unread MFS notifications for current user. Queries the mfs_ack table to calculate how many changelog entries the user hasn't read yet.

mark_all_read.doc: Mark all MFS notifications as read for current user. Updates the mfs_ack table with the last read changelog ID. If no last_id provided, uses the latest changelog ID from database.

last_id.description: Specific changelog ID to mark as last read. If not provided or 0, uses the latest changelog ID from database.

last_read_id.description: The changelog ID that was marked as last read

mtime.description: Unix timestamp when the read status was updated

get_feed.doc: Get paginated activity feed with read/unread status. Returns MFS changelog entries with pagination (45 items per page by default). Each item includes read status based on user's mfs_ack.last_read_id.

page.description: Page number for pagination (45 items per page)

returns.description: List of MFS activity items with read/unread status

action.description: Action type (upload, delete, move, copy, etc.)

author_id.description: User ID who performed the action

get_last_read.doc: Get last read changelog ID for current user. Queries the mfs_ack table from user's database to retrieve the last changelog ID the user has marked as read.

last_read_id.description: Last changelog ID marked as read (0 if never marked)

mtime.description: Unix timestamp of last update (0 if never updated)

acknowledge_file.doc: Mark a specific file/folder as seen. Updates the mfs_ack table with the changelog ID corresponding to this file/folder. Triggers WebSocket notification to update UI. Replaces old media.mark_as_seen which used JSON metadata.

nid.description: Node ID of the file/folder to acknowledge

last_read_id.description: The changelog ID that was marked as last read (only on success)

mtime.description: Unix timestamp when acknowledged (only on success)

log.doc: Get unified activity log (contacts + MFS) with priority sorting. Contact events are shown first, followed by MFS events. Pagination: 45 items per page. This provides a comprehensive activity timeline across both contact management and file operations.

page.description: Page number for pagination (45 items per page)

returns.description: Unified list of activity items from both contact and MFS events, sorted with contact events first

event_type.description: Type of event (contact_invite, contact_accept, mfs_upload, mfs_delete, etc.)

author_id.description: User ID who performed the action

target_id.description: Target user/node ID affected by the action

folder_log.doc: Get activity log for a specific folder. Shows all MFS events (upload, delete, move, copy, rename, etc.) related to a specific folder/node. Useful for tracking file activity within a particular directory. Pagination: 45 items per page.

nid.description: Node ID of the folder to get activity log for

page.description: Page number for pagination (45 items per page)

returns.description: List of MFS activity items for the specified folder

action.description: Action type (upload, delete, move, copy, rename, etc.)

author_id.description: User ID who performed the action

dismiss.doc: Dismiss a single activity notification so it no longer appears in the feed.

changelog_id.description: The changelog entry ID to dismiss

dismiss_contact_event.doc: Dismiss a single contact_activity row (hub invite, contact invite, etc.) so it no longer appears in the activity feed. Stamps yp.contact_activity.dismissed_at without deleting the underlying audit row.

activity_id.description: The yp.contact_activity row ID to dismiss

dismissed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the row was dismissed

list.doc: Single-call notification feed combining notification_center rollups + standalone hub-invite rows. Returns a flat array; client renders by `category` (chat | contact | media | teamchat | ticket | hub_invite).

dismiss_rollup.doc: Alias of notification_dismiss under the consolidated activity.* API. Hides a rollup row from the feed.

read.doc: Mark a rollup as read (advance read pointer) without hiding it. For chat/teamchat/ticket this is identical to dismiss; for media we only advance mfs_ack; for contact this is a no-op (use dismiss to hide).

create.doc: Publish a new notification via the activity.* namespace. Routes by category to the underlying table (mfs_changelog for media, contact_activity for invites). chat/teamchat/ticket are not supported here — use the domain endpoint (chat.post / channel.post / ticket.post).

notification_dismiss.doc: Unified dismiss for any rollup returned by drumate.notification_center. Routes by category to the right read-pointer/status update (chat → p2p_read, contact → contact.dismissed_at, media → mfs_dismissed, teamchat → <hub>.read_channel, ticket → yp.read_ticket_channel).

category.description: Rollup category: chat | contact | media | teamchat | ticket

key_id.description: Identifier the rollup uses (peer_id, contact id, hub_id, ticket_id)

hub_id.description: Hub id for the rollup (required for media + teamchat)
